name: Shishak
overview: Shishak, king of Egypt, played a significant role during the early divided monarchy of Israel and Judah. He provided refuge to Jeroboam when Solomon sought his life, allowing Jeroboam to remain in Egypt until Solomon's death (1 Kings 11:40). Later, in the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign, Shishak led a large military campaign against Jerusalem, capturing fortified cities of Judah and plundering the treasures of both the temple and the royal palace, including the gold shields made by Solomon (1 Kings 14:25-26; 2 Chronicles 12:2-4). This invasion was a direct consequence of the people's transgression against the LORD, demonstrating divine judgment through Shishak's actions.
